intro.en: Peer-reviewed by Paimon, cited by Paimon, funded by the Traveler. Reviewers may acquire a new nickname.
intro.zh: 派蒙审稿、派蒙引用、旅行者付钱。对审稿意见有异议的，将获得一个难听的外号。

title.zh: 派蒙学术文库 · 关系学三部曲

intro.en: Paimon writes about people she knows well. The acknowledgments have grown long enough to require their own table of contents.
intro.zh: 派蒙把熟悉的人写进书里。致谢越写越长，印刷店建议单独编一份目录。

entries.title: 《我的大贤者老师》
entries.eyebrow: 入学纪事 · 饭后修订版
entries.meta: 派蒙 著｜教令院旁边那家印刷店

summary.en: Alhaitham finished the enrollment paperwork before Paimon had finished asking about the cafeteria.
summary.zh: 艾尔海森替派蒙办好了入学，派蒙还在打听学生证能不能当饭卡。

details.en: Alhaitham proactively arranged Paimon's enrollment at the Akademiya, and this book follows her first encounters with student life. She initially checks the benefits attached to her new status. The curriculum soon gives her something else to read. Her account moves between the library and the cafeteria, with considerably fuller notes on the latter. When the draft reaches Alhaitham, Paimon has already written the acknowledgments and is still looking for a dissertation topic.
details.zh: 艾尔海森主动替派蒙办理了教令院入学，本书从派蒙拿到学籍后的生活写起。她先打听学生身份能领哪些补贴，随后才翻开培养方案。图书馆和食堂都去过，食堂那部分的笔记详细得多。写到导师指导时，派蒙认真回忆了艾尔海森推荐的书，也记下书有多厚。书稿送去请老师过目那天，致谢已经写好，开题还在想。

entries.title: 《我的朋友布耶尔》
entries.eyebrow: 净善宫谈话录 · 附赠一张借饭券
entries.meta: 派蒙 著｜净善宫门口流动书摊

summary.en: Paimon brings questions to the God of Wisdom and carefully records the answers about dinner.
summary.zh: 派蒙带着问题去找智慧之神，记得最牢的却是哪天一起吃了饭。

details.en: Paimon collects her conversations with Buer and gives each visit a chapter. Some visits begin with a question about the world and end with plans for dinner. Buer answers patiently, which leaves Paimon plenty of material to quote. During revision, a request for more references produces three additional photographs of them together. Paimon chooses the clearest photograph for the cover and keeps the original manuscript beside it.
details.zh: 派蒙把与布耶尔的几次见面整理成书，每去一趟便添一章。有时本来是去问世界树的事，聊着聊着就约好了晚饭。布耶尔讲得耐心，派蒙记得也认真，只是后来总先想起那顿饭。修改书稿时，布耶尔建议补充参考文献，派蒙带来了三张合影。她挑出最清楚的一张做封面，原稿仍按原来的页数送印。

entries.title: 《我的降临者伙伴》
entries.eyebrow: 旅行札记 · 钱包作者特别版
entries.meta: 派蒙 著｜旅行者背包出版社

summary.en: The Traveler carries the luggage while Paimon decides which adventures deserve another chapter.
summary.zh: 旅行者背着行李赶路，派蒙在旁边决定这段经历该写进第几章。

details.en: This travel memoir begins on the beach where the Traveler fished Paimon out of the water. Paimon records the people they meet and the meals that help her remember each place. The phrase 'we dealt with it' appears often, usually beside a much longer account of the Traveler doing the work. On rereading, Paimon adds several passages about how loudly she cheered. The Traveler finishes the manuscript quietly, and Paimon leaves a space on the back cover for a recommendation.
details.zh: 这本旅行札记从派蒙被旅行者钓上来的海滩写起，沿途见过的人与吃过的东西交替出现。遇到记不清的地名，她便先想附近卖什么。书里经常写「我们解决了」，后面跟着旅行者忙了好几页的经过。派蒙重读后补上一段，详细说明自己当时也在旁边加油。旅行者看完书稿，安静地把它合上，封底留给推荐语的位置还空着。

intro.en: The Traveler keeps the receipts for these projects. Paimon can usually identify the restaurant from the total.
intro.zh: 项目收据由旅行者保管。派蒙通常看一眼金额，就能想起是哪家店。

intro.en: Paimon's academic travels began on a beach. Her subsequent appointments have taken her considerably closer to a reliable lunch.
intro.zh: 派蒙的求学经历从海滩开始。后来的几次访问，都离稳定开饭的地方近了一点。

title.zh: 荣誉奖项（大部分自己颁的）

intro.en: Paimon keeps her certificates in the Traveler's backpack. She brings them out whenever someone asks what she contributes.
intro.zh: 奖状收在旅行者的背包里。每逢有人问派蒙到底有什么用，她就请旅行者拿出来。

intro.en: Available for invited talks, provided travel expenses include lunch, dinner, and the meal in between.
intro.zh: 欢迎邀请报告。差旅标准须包含午饭、晚饭及两者之间那顿。

title.en: News from a Very Small Scholar

intro.en: Recent publications and reports from Paimon's travels appear here. Updates tend to arrive shortly after a meal.
intro.zh: 这里收录最近的出版消息和旅途见闻。派蒙一般在吃饱后想起来更新。
